[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided hydration tips after a run:  
1. Drink water or a sports drink within 30 minutes of finishing your run.  
2. Choose a sports drink if you've run for over an hour or in extreme weather.  
3. Monitor your urine output and color.  
4. Consume electrolyte-rich foods.  
5. Avoid caffeine and alcohol.  
6. Make a hydration plan.  
7. Experiment with hydration tablets or powders.  
8. Drink water during your run if possible.  
9. Be mindful of the weather.  
10. Listen to your body.
